// Blood II's player characters, every value retail ships: the reference
// for a mod's Mod\Characters.txt. GENERATED by `testBlood2Tables --dump
// characters` from Blood2/Shared/CharacterValues.cpp; do not edit,
// regenerate. testBlood2Tables proves that loading this file as a mod
// changes nothing.
//
// A mod names only what it changes:
//
//     [CALEB]
//     EyeLevel = 40.0
//
// A section is the character's CHARACTER_ name (Shared/SharedDefs.h)
// without the prefix, in the define's spelling: GABREILLA.  Name is the
// sound directory, sounds\chosen\<Name>; Height sets only the first
// dims; Skin .. SkinTeamRed are the multiplayer skins, by
// MULTIPLAY_SKIN_, Skin the single-player one; Picture .. PictureYellow
// the character menu's, "" for none.  Strength .. Magic are the
// attributes the menu gives, 1-5, and the Switch ones an add-on level's
// switch's, 0 for the character's own; StartWeapons, StartItems and
// StartAmmo are what that switch leaves the player holding, by WEAP_,
// INV_ and AMMO_ name without the prefix, and StartAmmo a single-player
// respawn's too.  InitWeapons are the weapons a new single-player
// game's client asks for, in slots 1-9.  Every other number is 0 or
// more; a string is at most
// 99 characters.
//
// A section naming no character adds one, on a Base (a character here
// or a new one above it) as the mod leaves that one:
//
//     [SCARLET]
//     Base = "CALEB"
//     SkinRed = "Skins\Mod\scarlet_red.dtx"
//
// Blood2/Shared/BloodModCharacters.h has the rest.
